about.title: About
about.philosophyTitle: The richness of the past, for a new generation
about.inspirationBody: Forms, patterns and decorative elements from the Damascene environment, reinterpreted through a contemporary and refined design language.
about.body:
Damascense Studio was founded in Damascus in 2026 by architect Mahmoud Fattouh and Omar Al Morabet, Regional Manager at Hublot and founder of LiftX Advertising.

Born from a shared passion for the visual heritage of Damascus, the studio reinterprets forms, patterns and details inspired by the Damascene environment through a contemporary and refined design language.

From decorative mirrors and clocks to handcrafted wooden objects, each piece bridges the richness of the past with the aesthetics of modern interiors, carrying Damascene identity into a new generation.
